x: A word of praise for the winner, Furze, the old Watford Harrier, and now a member of the Polytechnic H., who ran in excellent style and won easily from a very classy field.
Charlie Smart adopted his usual forcing tactics and took the field along at a good pace. With a mile to go Furze, of the Poly, went ahead; with McIntyre, of Achilles, and Smart next, while H.

Also the field was a really “hot” one, the Achilles team being Ward, McIntyre and Ellis, while the Poly. had Reeve, Furze and Stockwell, and there were, of course, the Birchfield boys to be considered.
SIX MILES: Belgrave's ARTHUR PENNY (7) won from Rankine (Canada), Furze (5), Holden(6), Potts (8) and Oliver (Canada) in 31:00.
